title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: A solid audience recording captured with Sennheiser 421s; the show is praised as a good performance.
ai_review.review: The reviewer highlights that the audience tapes, especially Gans' Sennheiser 421 capture, deliver clear and enjoyable sound. Both the performance and the audio quality are described as good, making this a recommendable listen despite the lack of detailed song commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4 ★) which is positive about both sound and performance; rating reflects a generally good show with decent audience recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Nice audience captures; Sennheiser 421 microphones provide clear capture, noted as slightly ahead of other tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed commentary on set structure.
